description: budget.remove with the digest of the removal statement: a removal always loosens authority (a cap that is gone will never fire), so it always confirms, and the digest here is the SHA-256 of the statement the daemon rendered from the row — the same one a confirm-required refusal (errors/budget-refused-confirm-required.json) hands the client. The audit row outlives the budget (LC11): the removed caps are still readable in the audit of the subject, the view simply stops existing.
